messages:
mia (AE): looped in team for ZenithBank POC. they're switching from CompetitorX, main asks: response shape, stream framing, and parity on stop tokens.
dean (SE): got it. first Q: competitor returns choices[].text and a top_level.finished boolean. we return outputs[] and stream via SSE chunks with event:data. mapping should be straightforward but watch for chunk boundaries.
karim (solutions): Zenith provided 350 example prompts + a few edge cases where competitor returns empty choices or repeated system tokens. they expect identical user-visible text.
tara (eng): we can implement a compatibility shim in the proxy that converts outputs[0].content -> choices[0].text and sets finished when stream emits [DONE]. need clarity on how they interpret partial "is_final" markers.
zenith_cto: important: no silent truncation and stop-token handling must match. can you run a diff on our outputs vs competitor over our prompts?
dean (SE): we'll run token-level diffs and report metrics: exact match rate, average token edit distance, and stop-token mismatch count. can't promise byte-for-byte but will quantify.
lucy (security): security checklist: VPC peering, KMS, retention controls, compliance artifacts. do they require on-prem?
zenith_cto: prefer VPC + KMS. also need audit logs for every request for 7 years (enterprise policy).\lucy (security): 7-year retention is outside default, but enterprise add-on supports extended retention. DPA and SOC2 can be provided after NDA.
mi a (AE): pricing: Zenith billing model is per 1k tokens + reserved throughput. they want a like-for-like cost comparison for 10M tokens/mo.
karim (solutions): quick calc: base model $0.004/1k => 10,000 * 0.004 = $40/mo. quantized ~0.65x -> $26. network and reserved uplift TBD if they need Dedicated SLA.
dean (SE): additional ask: they want per-chunk confidence scores; we can stream logprobs but warn about perf impact. include as toggle in POC.
tara (eng): blocker: their client expects chunk-level metadata JSON field "confidence". our shim can insert token logprob -> confidence but that increases payload. need to validate client parser.
ci-bot: deploy queued: vendor-shim -> staging at 2025-11-12T09:00Z
zenith_cto: timeline: 10 business days. can you commit to that?
mia (AE): target: ingest prompt set + wire shim this week, run parity eval next week, demo end of week. dean, tara, karim own deliverables. lucy to start paperwork.
dean (SE): will push a small harness that emits CSV of diffs and a short report. will also include edge-case log with stop-token mismatches.
karim (solutions): I'll prepare SLA stub and cost breakdown for Dedicated vs Hosted.
mia (AE): thanks all — weekly stand-up invite coming. ping me for urgent items. :rocket:
